input:
Earlier scenes:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。妈妈认为，住离墓地太近，害得孟子的心气。孟子和孟母搬到子思老师的家，跟子思老师住。孟母帮子思打扫房间和做饭。子思帮孟母教她的儿子。因为孟子现在没有朋友，他老是读书。

This scene:
子思认为，对孩子来说，读书最重要，特别是学哲学。孟子不是练习写文章，就是看哲学书。孟子从五岁一直学哲学。他才五岁就学哲学，难怪他成为很有名的哲学家。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
(none on this scene)

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “对子思来说，读书最重要” Formula: 对 + 人 + 来说，+ statement Correct: “子思认为，对孩子来说，读书最重要。” “对子思来说” would mean “for Zisi,” but the sentence is about what is important for children.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “孟子不是练习写文章，就是看哲学书。” Formula: Subject + 不是 + V1，+ 就是 + V2 Correct: “孟子不是练习写文章，就是看哲学书。” This sentence is grammatically correct: it means he either practised writing or read philosophy books.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “孟子从五岁一直学哲学。” Formula: 从 + time + 开始，+ 一直 + V + 到/… Correct: “孟子从五岁开始一直学哲学。” Add “开始” after the starting age to make the time expression complete and natural.
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “他才五岁就学哲学。” Formula: 才 + number/age + 就 + V Correct: “他才五岁就开始学哲学。” The 才……就…… structure is correct here. Adding “开始” makes it clearer that age five was when he began learning philosophy.
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “难怪他成为很有名的哲学家。” Formula: 成为 + adjective + 的 + noun Correct: “难怪他后来成为了一位很有名的哲学家。” “后来” makes the timeline clearer, and “一位” is natural before a person’s profession.

items.reason: The student actually wrote “对孩子来说,” not “对子思来说,” so there is no error in the scene text.
“不是练习写文章，就是看哲学书” is already a correct 不是……就是…… structure.
“从五岁一直学哲学” is natural and complete; adding 开始 is optional rather than required.
“才五岁就学哲学” correctly uses 才……就……, and 开始 is only an optional clarification.
The becoming is a completed later event in the story, so adding 后来 and 了 makes the temporal relation clear and correct.
